entrance: # Reward targets for experiment <DATE>. Rename to <DATE>_targets.csv before use.
# entrance: NW / NE / SW / SE. Room directions; must match what Ethovision recorded.
# target_x, target_y: target coordinates in cm. Never (0, 0).
# trials: which trials use this row. Examples: all ; 1-20 ; 1,2,5 ; remaining ; Probe ; R*
# mice: blank = all mice. Or list IDs (e.g. 54,55) when the target differs by mouse.
# role: reward (default) or reverse (the rotated / previous target).
# Multiple reward rows matching one trial = that trial has multiple targets (K x 2).
